title: Salt Lake City's Guided Hiking Tour in the Rockies
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning landscapes of the Rockies on this all-inclusive guided hiking tour with lemonade, perfect for all experience levels. Starting at the park and ride at the bottom of Big Cottonwood Canyon just 15 mins from SLC, this 3-hour adventure takes you through trails boasting breathtaking mountain views. We will customize the hike based on group preferences and current trail conditions while soaking in the fresh mountain air and possibly spotting wildlife. Enjoy snack breaks and capture memories with photos to cherish forever.

- Ideal for those who want to hike of all levels, ages 10 and up
- Customized hiking experience based on group preferences and current conditions
- Connect with nature and enjoy stunning mountain views
- Lemonade, trail mix, water, and snacks provided
- Bring clothing layers to stay warm in changing weather conditions
